response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS m FROM Laboratory), ab AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a FROM p, o WHERE p.a > o.m) SELECT ID, a AS avg_hgb, a - (SELECT m FROM o) AS above_overall_avg, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM ab) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM ab ORDER BY diff_from_above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: 'Overall average hemoglobin' is the average of HGB across all lab records (each record weighted equally), ignoring NULLs.
The 'average of these above-average patients' averages' is the unweighted mean of their per-patient averages.
Patients with no non-null HGB values are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: Overall average is the mean of per-patient average HGB values (each patient weighted equally) instead of the record-level mean.
